primary_goal: verify whether component-preset compatibility inputs need a separate persisted migration layer beyond version-1 canonical rewrite
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

scope.phase: legacy aliases, ignored detail fields, first mutation rewrite, reload, and unsupported versions
scope.trigger: version-1 persisted record uses compatible aliases or a future/old version marker

problem_domain_closure.version_contract: only exact integer version 1 is accepted
problem_domain_closure.canonical_rewrite: first successful mutation writes id/component canonical keys
problem_domain_closure.reload: canonical file reloads without a migration sidecar
problem_domain_closure.api_and_concurrency: no source change; inherited H13-H16 API/lock contracts remain covered by the parent full suite

data_roles.holdout: unsupported version types and reload after canonical rewrite

guardrails: do not add a migration layer without evidence of a real versioned format gap
keep version-1 compatibility bounded and explicit
preserve H16 canonical rewrite and H13/H14 error contracts
reuse parent full regression because no source changed
next_step: find a new source-grounded candidate outside the already closed component-preset persistence domain
